config.study: Exploratory severity sweep of frozen clean-trained and noise-augmented 224px probes
config.models: Unchanged selected heads, shared original scaler and frozen ImageNet encoder from high_resolution/augmentation; original calibration cutoffs preserved
config.perturbations: 224px input Gaussian noise, seed 42 per original test index; same underlying random field scaled across strengths. Reflect Gaussian blur on source images. Clip to [0,1] and round uint8. Zero severity reproduces clean exactly.
config.primary: Augmented-minus-control error at 80% fractional-tie coverage under noise SD=0.2, specified before evaluation of the new severity points
config.secondary: Full noise/blur curves: risk at 80%, original-cutoff coverage and accepted error, AUROC, accuracy, NLL, Brier, ECE. Reproduce previously observed noise 0.1 and blur 8 exactly. No selection of favorable severity or head.
config.simultaneous_band: Exploratory joint sensitivity band for augmented-minus-control risk at 80% over all 10 distinct grid points: radius is 95th percentile of maximum absolute centered paired-bootstrap deviation across the grid. No extrapolation between grid points, no clinical coverage guarantee.
config.numerics: Primary uses historical top-label probability confidence with fractional ties. Report saturated probabilities and compare ranking by absolute logits as a separate numerical sensitivity, without silently changing endpoints.
config.scope: Known internal benchmark, fixed models/thresholds, same 621 test representatives at all severities, no new training or external validation. Image bootstrap omits training/model selection and unknown patient correlation.
